Definition: to shrink, i.e. thicken (as unracked wine, curdled milk, clouded sky, frozen water)
BiblicalUsage: To thicken is the word for waters standing up and milk curdling: the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea, Job asks whether God has not curdled him like cheese, and the men settled on their lees say the LORD will not do good, neither will He do evil.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the thickening as both miracle and warning: the sea stood still for God's people, and the settled dregs are the men who stopped expecting God to act.
